newsitem.title: USA: Lloyd's wins federal court ruling in Utah.
newsitem.headline: Lloyd's wins federal court ruling in Utah.

text.p: Lloyd's of London Friday said the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah denied a motion to send back to state court a lawsuit by the state of Utah alleging Lloyd's violated state securities laws.
The action had been removed from state court to federal court.
Besides denying the motion, Judge Dee Benson also ruled that a temporary restraining order issued by the state court against Lloyd's was no longer in effect, Lloyd's said.
Lloyd's said also that the court's ruling said it will likely dismiss the action.
Peter Lane, the managing director of Lloyd's North America, said the company hoped to offer Utah the agreement reached between Lloyd's and the North American Securities Administrators Association.
Lane said the agreement has been accepted by 39 other states and the District of Columbia.
